follow-up time: 4 years (1 year before and 3 years after participation in the JANIS programme)
exposure: participation in the Japan Nosocomial Infection Surveillance (JANIS) programme
receipt of an annual feedback report 1 year after participation in the JANIS programme
cohort: Patients who had undergone surgeries targeted for SSI surveillance at JANIS hospitals between 2012 and 2017
finding: Participation in the JANIS programme was associated with improved SSI prevention performance in several surgical procedures in Japanese hospitals after 3 years.
